idea: Run an exact branch-and-bound over integer square dissections of a k×k board (k = ⌈√n⌉ … ⌈√n⌉+3). Enumerate only "grid plus a single non-unit square of side a placed at a corner, with the cells covered by it removed", and also the dual case where cells are split into 2×2. Take the best exact count n, as a fast closed-form family indexed by (k, a, number of 2×2 splits).
